text: harness-all-in-dsh 是一款面向 DSH Web 与命令行配置的 Agent Harness 插件，提供 13 种固定的智能体工作方式。它通过 Agent preset 选择 ReAct、计划执行、上下文总结、记忆检索和多智能体协调等实现，并在 DSH 会话循环中注册对应提示、工具与可回放状态。用户可按任务需要切换线性计划、轨迹折叠或并行候选答案汇总等机制，也可使用 Web 预设或 headless 配置文件运行。适合希望在 DSH 内比较和使用不同 Agent 编排机制的开发者；插件本身没有声明额外 API 密钥或账号要求。

harness-all-in-dsh adds 13 agent harnesses to DSH Web and CLI profiles. Each mode connects prompts, tools, and replayable session state to the DSH agent loop. Options include planning, memory retrieval, trajectory folding, and multi-agent coordination. No extra API key or account is declared.

harness-all-in-dsh 的功能「固定 Harness 选择」：在配置中选择 13 种 Agent 实现之一，默认使用 ReAct；插件按选择注册相应提示、工具及会话状态机制。
harness-all-in-dsh 的功能「线性计划与进度回顾」：Plan-and-Execute 模式提供提交路线和记录进度的工具，并将计划状态保存在会话投影中，按配置间隔提示回顾。
harness-all-in-dsh 的功能「独立尝试与证据汇总」：AggAgent 为同一任务启动多个隔离的子 Agent，再提供轨迹检索和片段读取，让协调 Agent 检查候选答案后提交综合结果。

harness-all-in-dsh README · harness-all-in-dsh：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Reproductions of published Agent Harnesses built as native [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugins and Agent presets.

The project currently provides 13 fixed Harnesses. Original papers and official implementations are the primary references; each research note records the inspected revision and intentional differences.

harness-all-in-dsh README · Why this project：- Run every Harness through supported `dsh` profiles instead of a separate launcher.
- Preserve model-visible plans, summaries, memory transitions, child results, and aggregation results in DSH Session data.
- Reuse the DSH Agent loop, subagent providers, scoped tools, and surface replacement instead of embedding another general-purpose Agent runtime.
- Compare Harnesses under the same model, task, tool, and budget settings.
- Separate implemented mechanism fidelity from future benchmark claims.

| ReSum | Context-pressure summarization and restart | Session surface compaction |
| Flash-Searcher | Dependency DAG and ready-node scheduling | Validated DAG projection and bounded parallel calls |

harness-all-in-dsh README · Included Harnesses：All 13 Harnesses are implemented at mechanism level. Benchmark comparisons require a matched evaluation matrix and are not claimed by this repository.

harness-all-in-dsh README · Use the Harnesses in DSH Web：Install this repository as a bundle in the `web` profile, then restart DSH Web:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/harness-all-in-dsh
dsh web
```

Create a new Session and choose one of the modes whose name starts with `Harness ·`. A Session that already contains messages cannot change its Agent preset.
section: Use the Harnesses in DSH Web

text: harness-all-in-dsh README · Use the Harnesses in DSH Web：The presets share Shell, filesystem, search, Skill, and user-question tools. Planning, memory, folding, compaction, and child-Agent behavior come only from the selected Harness. The Web process owns the deployment-wide parallel tool-call limit, so a preset does not override that setting.
section: Use the Harnesses in DSH Web

text: harness-all-in-dsh README · Use the Harnesses in DSH Web：Harness tools remain visible throughout a Session, so planning and memory state changes do not rewrite the model-facing tool catalogue. Plan-and-Execute and Flash-Searcher allow workspace inspection and fact gathering before the initial plan; periodic reviews and GAM maintenance are model-visible recommendations. Coordinator Harnesses still reject ordinary task tools because those actions belong to their child Agents. Admission decisions are frozen for one model response, and protocol denials remain in the Session log for diagnostics but do not become task evidence, memory, trajectory entries, or progress counts.

harness-all-in-dsh README · Run a Harness from the command line：Create a profile from `headless`, install the bundle, and apply the selected Harness overlay:

```sh
dsh --profile harness-react --from-default-profile headless --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile harness-react add /absolute/path/to/harness-all-in-dsh
dsh --profile harness-react --patch /absolute/path/to/harness-all-in-dsh/profiles/react.cordis.patch.yml "your task"
```
